title: Final Beat Frequency
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the beat frequency as omega_beat = omega/(1-beta).

title: Final Beta Value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the value of beta as approximately 0.999001.

title: Wave Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the incident and reflected wave equations.

title: Frequency Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of the frequency transformation due to the moving wall.

title: Use of Sinusoidal Identity
description: Optional Criteria: The student may use the sinusoidal identity to combine the incident and reflected waves effectively.

title: Understanding of Beat Concept
description: Optional Criteria: The student should explain the concept of beats and how they arise from the superposition of waves.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the frequency transformation calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
